query:
UPDATE transactions
        SET tx_ts = $2
        WHERE balance_doc_id = $1
          AND (
              tx_ts > $2
              OR tx_ts <= COALESCE(
                  (SELECT MAX(d.balance_ts) FROM balance_docs d WHERE d.account_id = $3 AND d.balance_ts < $2),
                  '-infinity'::timestamptz
              )
          )
